This initiative is backed by a generous $6.25 billion commitment from the Michael and Susan Dell Foundation, with more than fifty companies already on board.

title: Nitin Gadkari urges all state governments to allow bike taxis
content: Union minister Nitin Gadkari urged states to allow bike taxis for employment.  He also announced a negative point system for traffic violations.  This new system will lead to license suspension and cancellation for offenders.  A pilot program for driver medical diagnosis was also launched.  This initiative aims to improve road safety and worker well-being.

title: Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre castle estate in Ireland; spokesperson says: Mark and his family are excited to continue caring for ...
content: In a remarkable real estate move, Meta's Mark Zuckerberg and his wife Priscilla Chan have purchased the enchanting Strancally Castle in County Waterford, encompassing 440 acres. This magnificent estate will serve as their residence during visits to Ireland, where Meta’s global operations are anchored. The castle boasts a rich heritage, thanks to a 25-year restoration by its former owners.

title: 'November is a priority’: Trump aides push to contain Iran war until midterm elections
content: Top Trump aides push to prevent Iran war escalation before November elections. The administration is focusing on economic pressure to secure concessions from Iran. Recent exchanges of strikes have increased tensions between the US and Iran. Military readiness and depleted munitions stockpiles also constrain White House strategy. America's Gulf allies are urging the White House to de-escalate the conflict.

title: Supporters raise $2.8m to save Houston's 1947 Art Deco theater from demolition
content: Houston's historic Garden Oaks Theater faced demolition after its sale in 2025. A local preservation campaign successfully raised funds to acquire the property. The nonprofit Arthouse Houston plans to transform the building into an arts and film center. This new center will combine historic preservation with new cultural uses. The completed center is targeted for a grand opening in 2028.

title: SpaceX sends $4.3bn Roman Space Telescope to look for 'weird, rare’ stars, planets
content: SpaceX has achieved another milestone by successfully launching NASA's Roman Space Telescope into orbit. This groundbreaking observatory is designed to delve into the mysteries of distant planets and the enigmatic forces of dark energy. Its expansive field of view is one hundred times that of the Hubble Space Telescope, enabling it to work in tandem with other instruments, paving the way for extraordinary cosmic discoveries awaiting our exploration.

title: 'New peaks of lethality': IAF tests Khagantak-243; all about long range glide bomb
content: The Indian Air Force has achieved a major milestone by successfully testing the Khagantak-243 glide bomb. This homegrown weapon enhances India's stand-off precision strike capability, covering distances of over 140 km once released from an aircraft. Developed in partnership by Bharat Electronics Limited and JSR Dynamics, this test underscores India's commitment to defence innovation.

title: China's Xi tells Middle East to be ‘masters of their own destiny’ amid Iran war

Both leaders agreed to deepen security and economic cooperation between their nations.  China seeks to expand its influence and safeguard vital shipping routes.  Egypt is diversifying its international partnerships by strengthening ties with Beijing.

Paul earns from WWE and digital media, entrepreneurship and other business interests, while Cena has been earning from WWE, Hollywood acting and endorsements for decades. Their projected net worth in 2026 reveals the financial trajectory of modern internet-driven business ownership, which can differ from traditional wrestling and entertainment success.

Investigators are now working to identify other gang members and trace stolen goods.

title: World war 2: The deadliest conflict in human history ended 81 years ago today

Triggered by Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland in 1939, this global war escalated when Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, drawing the United States into the fray. The tide turned with the Allied forces’ victories, leading to Germany's surrender in May 1945.
